name: Group Header 131
definition: Set of characteristics shared by all individual transactions included in the message.

MessageIdentification.name: Message Identification
MessageIdentification.definition: Point to point reference, as assigned by the instructing party, and sent to the next party in the chain to unambiguously identify the message.|Usage: The instructing party has to make sure that MessageIdentification is unique per instructed party for a pre-agreed period.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the message was created.

ExpiryDateTime.name: Expiry Date Time
ExpiryDateTime.definition: Date and time on which the payment should be expired if it has not settled.

BatchBooking.name: Batch Booking
BatchBooking.definition: Identifies whether a single entry per individual transaction or a batch entry for the sum of the amounts of all transactions within the group of a message is requested.|Usage: Batch booking is used to request and not order a possible batch booking.

NumberOfTransactions.name: Number Of Transactions
NumberOfTransactions.definition: Number of individual transactions contained in the message.

ControlSum.name: Control Sum
ControlSum.definition: Total of all individual amounts included in the message, irrespective of currencies.

TotalInterbankSettlementAmount.name: Total Interbank Settlement Amount
TotalInterbankSettlementAmount.definition: Total amount of money moved between the instructing agent and the instructed agent.

InterbankSettlementDate.name: Interbank Settlement Date
InterbankSettlementDate.definition: Date on which the amount of money ceases to be available to the agent that owes it and when the amount of money becomes available to the agent to which it is due.

SettlementInformation.name: Settlement Information
SettlementInformation.definition: Specifies the details on how the settlement of the transaction(s) between the instructing agent and the instructed agent is completed.

PaymentTypeInformation.name: Payment Type Information
PaymentTypeInformation.definition: Set of elements used to further specify the type of transaction.

InstructingAgent.name: Instructing Agent
InstructingAgent.definition: Agent that instructs the next party in the chain to carry out the (set of) instruction(s).

InstructedAgent.name: Instructed Agent
InstructedAgent.definition: Agent that is instructed by the previous party in the chain to carry out the (set of) instruction(s).

TotalInterbankSettlementAmountAndDateRul.definition: If TotalInterbankSettlementAmount is present, then InterbankSettlementDate must be present.
